top_signals.title: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
top_signals.summary: Analysts warn an export ban could backfire, pushing up global diesel prices and potentially triggering higher U.S. gasoline prices as refiners adjust.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JCB Succession Decided With Founder’s Grandson Made Co-Chair
top_signals.summary: J.C. Bamford Excavators Ltd. said that George Bamford will become joint chairman alongside his father, marking the first change at the top of one of the UK’s biggest private companies in more than 50 years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
top_signals.summary: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
